extracted.name: Slow Cooker Pinto Beans
extracted.description: Slow cooker pinto beans and ham simmer to tender perfection in a savory broth in your crockpot. It's easy, just pre-soak your beans the night before!
ingredient_lines: 1 pound dried pinto beans, soaked overnight
1 tablespoon dried oregano, or to taste
1 teaspoon ground cumin, or to taste
5 cups chicken broth, or as needed to cover
instruction_lines: Place beans in a large bowl and cover with water. Allow to soak 8 hours to overnight. Drain.
Place soaked pinto beans in a slow cooker. Add ham, onion, bell pepper, celery, garlic, oregano, lard, cumin, and bay leaves. Pour in enough chicken broth to cover all ingredients.
Pour in enough chicken broth to cover all ingredients.
Cook on High until beans are very tender, 5 to 6 hours.
